svg.text: The central database shared by the six modules: 21 classes, their key attributes, operations and relationships

text.tspan: a seat is sold only once
«tenant»: the record belongs to exactly one Agency
(agencyId). Every query is filtered by the agency of
the logged-in user, so one agency never sees another.
The 11 lines to Agency are not drawn, to keep the
An attribute typed with a class (actor: Employee,
payer: User, origin: Branch...) is an association
ParcelEvent is {append-only}: one row per scan
(who, when, where). Never updated or deleted.
Secrets are never stored in clear: passwords (bcrypt),
reset codes, delivery codes and invite tokens

svg.text: Rules that connect the modules (the same database transaction)
a bus IN_MAINTENANCE stops seat sales on its future trips
a driver whose licence has expired cannot be assigned to a trip
every paid ticket and parcel creates a Payment (with the platform fee)
cash on delivery stays in Escrow until the receiver gives the right code
maintenance and fuel costs become Expenses automatically
parcels travel on the same Trip that Booking sells seats on
Composition (the part is deleted with the whole)
Multiplicity: 1 = exactly one · 0..1 = zero or one · * or 0..* = any number · 1..* = at least one
Visibility: - private attribute · + public operation · [0..1] = optional · {unique} = no two rows share it
Money: Int in FCFA · Dates: DateTime (UTC) · Source of truth: server/prisma/schema.prisma
